projectContext: Sprint 33 focuses on Mullvad VPN integration as Tier 4 bypass, download improvements with VPN-aware budgeting, and documentation. The codebase has a mature 3-tier escalation system (impersonation → extractor-args → cookie rotation). Mullvad adds a 4th tier for IP rotation when cookie rotation is exhausted. Key integration points: EscalationManager (src/downloader/escalation_manager.py), CircuitBreaker (src/downloader/circuit_breaker.py), RateLimitBudget (src/downloader/rate_limit_budget.py). Existing VPNManager (src/downloader/vpn_manager.py) is generic; this sprint creates Mullvad-specific implementation with `mullvad` CLI commands and `am.i.mullvad.net` verification.
